functions.desc: Invert process settings to hit output targets; returns a recommendation table.

args.name: data
args.desc: History table with headers; may include request rows with blank adjustable columns. SharedOutput* columns pool one shared rate.

args.name: [request]
args.desc: Optional separate request table with the same headers; data is then pure history.

args.name: [bounds]
args.desc: Optional bounds table (variable name or index, lower, upper); defaults to history min/max.

args.name: [model]
args.desc: Model: auto (default), linear, poly, rate or rate_poly.

args.name: [seed]
args.desc: Random seed for optimizer and sampling; default 42.

functions.expr: SolveCore.Inverse( RequiredTable(data, "data"), OptionalTable(request), OptionalTable(bounds), InputNormalizer.ToString(model), InputNormalizer.IsOmitted(seed) ? 42L : InputNormalizer.ToLong(seed), InputNormalizer.IsOmitted(maxStarts) ? 10 : InputNormalizer.ToInt32(maxStarts))
